name: All That Is Left
source:
After the tragic death of her ex-girlfriend Yves, Sera finds herself haunted. As Yves’ presence grows stronger, she begins to manipulate Sera’s thoughts—dragging her deeper into a cycle of guilt and longing, and isolating her from those who still care, including her current girlfriend, Irina.

Sera must confront whether Yves ever truly left… or if she ever wanted her to.

[From [url=https://justharoo.itch.io/all-that-is-left]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
前女友伊夫不幸去世后，塞拉发现自己陷入了困扰。随着伊夫的存在变得越来越强大，她开始操纵塞拉的思想——将她拖入更深的内疚和渴望的循环中，并将她与那些仍然关心她的人隔离开来，包括她现任女友伊琳娜。

塞拉必须面对伊夫是否真的离开过……或者她是否希望她离开。

[来自[url=https://justharoo.itch.io/all-that-is-left]itch.io[/url]]
